name: Blue Security Keycard
description: A blue keycard that grants access to Director Dustbane's office

interactions.examine: A blue plastic keycard with the Intergalactic Sanitation Bureau logo embossed on it. The magnetic strip on the back still works, apparently. It's labeled 'MANAGEMENT ACCESS - DO NOT LOSE (Again).' You're not sure where you got this from, but you're grateful to have it.
interactions.take: You pick up the blue keycard and slip it into your pocket. One step closer to facing your boss's wrath... er, explaining the situation professionally.
